facts.text: [low] An error is raised if Atlas cannot start compute auto-scaling for operational nodes because the configured storage size is not supported by the target tier. Sources: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/reference/alert-conditions.md

[low] Atlas compute auto-scaling moves a dedicated cluster between a minimum and maximum tier based on sustained CPU and memory usage, allowing clusters with daily or weekly load cycles to run on a smaller tier outside their peaks. Sources: https://www.pointfive.co/efficiency-hub/cloud-services/mongodb-atlas
